name: Arabella House
notes:
Linden Oaks's home in Naperville for women with eating disorders, a step between intensive treatment and living at home; residents had to have been through treatment first, and the house held eight women at a time (Daily Herald, 2010).

Described as Linden Oaks's residential care home for women with eating disorders (Patch).

Closed in 2012 while Linden Oaks stayed open (public data submission, 2026-10-04).

Added 2026-10-21 from the Linden Oaks record (seeds/young-adult-programs.json): filed as a young adult program because every source describes it as serving women.
